The procedure combined medical knowledge with spiritual ritual, often accompanied by prayers and incantations. Some scholars argue these surgeries influenced Greek medicine centuries later. The practice highlights a civilization willing to risk life to challenge the mysteries of the mind. Trepanation in Egypt seems less about science and more about audacious experimentation.

The knowledge, whether ritualistic or empirical, shaped how the brain was perceived for centuries.
